name: frotaone
description: FrotaOne — plataforma SaaS de gestão de frotas e locadoras (reconstrução fiel das referências visuais).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @frotaone/contracts && npm run build -w @frotaone/api && npm run build -w @frotaone/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @frotaone/api" "npm run dev -w @frotaone/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @frotaone/contracts && npm run test -w @frotaone/api && npm run test -w @frotaone/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @frotaone/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @frotaone/api && npm run typecheck -w @frotaone/web
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:demo -w @frotaone/api" "npm run dev -w @frotaone/web"
